newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht steady in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht steady in late trade.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate was steady at 13.00 percent in slow late trade on Tuesday from 12.50-13.00 percent early amid continued tight liquidity, dealers said.
"The market was quiet today. The high overnight interbank rate sidelined most borrowers," said one dealer at European bank.
Dealers said the tight liquidity was due to commercial banks' early fund borrowing for the next reserve requirement, recent buying of the dollar and the payment of value added tax (VAT).
The baht was quoted at 25.423-25.428 to the dollar late against 25.422-25.427 earlier, dealers said.
"The dollar was well bid from foreign players today. But the dollar/baht spot rate was stuck in a narrow range of 25.420-25.426," one currency dealer said.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was quoted at 9.80/10.80 satangs per dollar late from 10.25/11.25 in early morning.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the dollar/baht mid-rate at 25.40 versus 25.42 on Monday.
